notes.content:
[h3][b]📌 Improvements & Additions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][p][u][b]Added 2 new types of infected creatures![/b][/u][/p][/*]
[*][p]Set a maximum spawn limit to prevent creatures from endlessly spawning from spawners.[/p][/*]
[*][p][u][b]Optimized overall creature AI performance.[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][/*]
[*][p]All primary and secondary weapons now display a laser sight when aiming.[/p][/*]
[*][p]Unified and improved knockback animation ranges across all weapons.[/p][p][/p][/*]
[*][p][u][b]Stage maps now only reveal areas the player has explored.[/b][/u][/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/32234752c672117cbff95daf5a81f2bfba82c00e.gif"][/img][/p]
[p]Because zone numbers can no longer be previewed, visual markers have been placed to help players infer each zone.[/p][/*]
[/list]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/4017ccc90daac576553ddd3b322eec5fba157599.png"][/img][/p]
[p][/p]
[list]
[*][p]Adjusted the minimum and maximum zoom levels of the map camera.[/p][/*]
[*][p]Added experimental bullet ricochet mechanics based on the angle of impact.[/p][/*]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]📌 Notice on Chinese & Russian Language Support[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Font compatibility[/b][/h3]
[p]We aimed to roll out multilingual support (including Chinese and Russian) quickly, but our current pixel fonts [b]Galmuri 9 / Galmuri 11[/b] do not fully support these character sets and readability is poor.[/p]
[p]Therefore, we will [b]switch to a more legible font and apply it in the [i]next update[/i][/b]. While it won’t be a pixel-style font, this change is necessary to clearly display multiple languages. We will also [b]continue exploring ways to improve the original pixel fonts for multilingual use[/b].[/p]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]China server connectivity[/b][/h3]
[p]We currently use [b]Photon servers[/b], and our base plan does [b]not include a China region server[/b]. As a result, many players in China connect to Korea, Japan, or other Asia servers, which can cause matchmaking delays and latency.[/p]
[p]We are actively evaluating options to [b]add and connect a China server[/b] so players in China can enjoy a smoother experience.[/p]
[p]We apologize for the inconvenience, and [b]these issues will be addressed progressively in upcoming updates[/b].[/p]

notes.title: BLACKOUT Demo – Feedback Summary and Development Plans
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is SILOEGI Operation.
We sincerely thank everyone who participated in the demo.
Your interest and diverse feedback for BLACKOUT have been a great source of strength for us.[/p][p]Now that the BIC offline exhibition has ended, we would like to share the first roadmap and upcoming tasks based on your feedback.
While we want to present a clear month-by-month schedule, external events such as Tokyo Game Show in September and Gamescom Asia in October prevent us from committing to exact dates.
The order below does not represent the importance of feedback, but simply the order in which tasks will be handled. Every piece of feedback matters to us.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Top Priority[/b][/h3][p]The most urgent tasks are bugs that directly affect gameplay.
Most are related to server connection issues, and we will work on gradual improvements.[/p][olist][*][p]Bug where characters disappear and controls are disabled after boarding the extraction shuttle[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where room creation fails and controls freeze after server switching[/p][/*][*][p]Severe latency when a certain player is the host, even within the same region[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where certain interactions cause the character to freeze, body parts to vanish, or weapons to stop firing[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b]High Priority[/b][/h3][p]Improvements requested by many players, mainly regarding controls and language support.[/p][olist][*][p]Full Controller Support[/p][list][*][p]Currently only partially functional in-game, with missing key prompts, making controllers nearly unplayable.[/p][/*][*][p]We will implement full support including UI navigation, key display, and better responsiveness across all devices.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Additional Language Support[/p][list][*][p]Based on Steam forum activity and download data, players from many regions are enjoying the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Some translations are nearly complete but were AI-generated, so player feedback will be crucial after release.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]UI/UX Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Feedback showed that gadget wheel, quickslot, and mission progress UI were difficult to understand.[/p][/*][*][p]Our goal is a challenging co-op game, but the challenge should never come from bad UX.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements will be gradual, but we are committed to making the interface more intuitive.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b]Medium Priority[/b][/h3][p]This section covers long-term but highly important content additions.[/p][olist][*][p]Player Progression & Equipment[/p][list][*][p]Current gameplay is heavily limited to “shooting guns.”[/p][/*][*][p]We plan to add melee gear (breach hammer, tactical shield), special gear (sentry guns, drones), class systems (support, vanguard, etc.), and tactical items (mines, incendiary rounds, AP rounds) to expand strategy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Creature AI Improvements & New Types[/p][list][*][p]Some creatures failed to detect players or behaved unnaturally in vertical positions.[/p][/*][*][p]We will add new types such as flying enemies and more special abilities to enrich combat variety.[/p][/*][*][p](We have not yet decided on an official term for these creatures—player suggestions are welcome!)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]More Stages & Missions[/p][list][*][p]Current missions are too interaction-based and felt lacking.[/p][/*][*][p]We plan to introduce mini-games and more diverse objectives, similar to Helldivers’ antenna missions.[/p][/*][*][p]We also aim to add special optional zones like “Overload” in RD2—very difficult missions requiring true teamwork.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b]Low Priority[/b][/h3][p]Convenience features that are not urgent but necessary in the long term.[/p][olist][*][p]Tutorial improvements and skip option[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustable screen shake and color filters[/p][/*][*][p]Steam nickname integration and fixed-name setting[/p][/*][*][p]Steam friend invite integration[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p][b]Closing[/b][/p][p][u][b]Once again, thank you for playing the demo. Every single piece of feedback has been meaningful and helpful.[/b][/u][/p][p]We are very happy that so many players enjoyed BLACKOUT, the first title we’ve been working on since our university days.
We will continue striving to make this a game built together with all of you.[/p][p]We appreciate your continued interest and support. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: [Dev Log] #1 Co-op Shooters and Side-Scrolling
notes.content:
[p][/p][h2]Hello, this is SILOEGI Operation.[/h2][p]With the demo release just around the corner, we'd like to briefly introduce how BLACKOUT began and the direction it’s heading.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Development Started After Military Discharge[/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/d63448a975c5d67e3f16dc650ffaf5d9f8e0e013.png"][/img][/h2][p]BLACKOUT is a game we started developing with friends after completing our military service. We’ve always loved co-op shooters like [i]Left 4 Dead 2[/i] and [i]Alien Swarm[/i], so the release of [i]GTFO[/i] was especially exciting for us.[/p][p][i]GTFO[/i] was a major inspiration for BLACKOUT.
Its teamwork-based structure, brutally challenging difficulty, grotesque creatures, and dark atmosphere — these were all elements our team was passionate about.[/p][p]While [i]GTFO[/i] was a game we genuinely enjoyed, our first experience playing it turned out to be a little different from what we had expected.[/p][p]At first, we thought it would be a shooter where we could go in guns blazing and mow down creatures — but in reality, the gameplay was centered around stealth and assassination.[/p][p]
[/p][p]So we thought:[/p][h3]Let’s make a game that focuses entirely on [b][u]shooting[/u][/b]![/h3][p]While inspired by the hardcore tone of [i]GTFO[/i], we decided to develop BLACKOUT with full-on firefights and action at its core, rather than stealth mechanics.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]A Side-Scrolling Co-op Shooter?[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/3e965a45398f8eb5aa3d9996a468c810d56afe26.png"][/img][/p][p]There are already a lot of amazing games where you can shoot creatures to your heart’s content.[/p][p]To stand out, we thought back to a game we enjoyed before military service: [i]Katana ZERO[/i]. Most co-op shooters are either 3D or belt-scroll 2D, so we thought...[/p][h3]“Wouldn’t it be awesome to make a [b][u]side-scrolling co-op shooter[/u][/b]?”[/h3][p]Of course, as we began development, we quickly realized why there are so few side-scrolling co-op shooters. Ha...[/p][p]
[/p][p]The biggest challenge we faced was the limitation of [b][u]directional axis[/u][/b].[/p][p]Co-op shooters are fun because you split up and cover different angles, but side-scrollers restrict that to left and right.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]360° Shooting – Handcrafted Pixel by Pixel[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/6c10063750b5243f54d63fbeac2502f21dc2cf4f.gif"][/img][/p][p][b][u]To address this, we made aiming full 360 degrees.[/u][/b][/p][p]We considered pixelating spine rigs or 3D models, but instead, we drew nearly 180 degrees’ worth of pixel animation frames by hand.[/p][p]This handmade pixel art let us express tactical details like gun mounting and reloading in a more dynamic way.[/p][p](Probably because we had just finished our military service and were obsessed with tactical details...)[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/ea67454f3d5086cb08c7062d8b08aa824f5fbbf0.png"][/img][/p][p]Then we focused on developing environments to support 360° combat—platforms with bullet holes, varied terrain, and more to increase density and variety.[/p][p]We’re still refining it, but making steady progress.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Our Direction Moving Forward[/h2][p]Our next goals are to expand [b]aiming directions[/b] and enhance [b]co-op gameplay[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/1f63d899e26194ccecf85b132df9f090f9ec8b5f.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]For [b][i][u]aiming[/u][/i][/b], while not included in the demo, we plan to add airborne and ceiling-crawling enemies to introduce more threats from above and increase aiming variety.[/p][p]
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/99e5aea0fc4142e39f4de8d484f31eed67e350f1.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/c9c3939ddd5977b0758b274e358c1621e67311d6.gif"][/img][/carousel][p]
[/p][p]We’re also concerned about the current lack of role differentiation in co-op. We’ll definitely improve this based on feedback.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Since the gunplay and aiming were done manually, the number of weapons is limited. Instead, we’ve been working to diversify [b]mission types[/b] to reduce repetition and boost immersion.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Another key part of co-op fun is equipment and role specialization.[/p][p]While not in the demo, we’re preparing to add [b]special gadgets like sentry guns[/b] to diversify gameplay further.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b][u]We need your help![/u][/b][/h3][p]We’re a small and relatively inexperienced team. We’ve had many failures and setbacks throughout development, and we know there’s still a long way to go.[/p][p]Through this demo, we hope to gather your feedback and build a [b]game completed together with players[/b].[/p][p](To be honest, after developing for so long without player interaction, every word of support or feedback means the world to us.)[/p][p]
[/p][p]We’ll see you in the demo on July 31. Thank you!!   [/p]

notes.title: Nice to meet you — We are SILOEGI Operation.
notes.content: [p][/p][h3][b]Nice to meet you. [/b][/h3][h3]We are SILOEGI Operation — chasing passion over efficiency, and challenge over familiarity.[/h3][p][/p][p]Our team is currently developing the hardcore co-op shooter \[BLACKOUT].[/p][p]\[BLACKOUT] is a side-scrolling cooperative shooter where you become the last special forces unit and fight against infected threats in the Earth Federation.[/p][p][/p][p]To be honest, it's been a while since we launched the Steam page... but due to school and development, we haven't been able to engage much until now.[/p][p]However, we've all graduated now, and we’re fully focused on development!![/p][p]From now on, we plan to communicate regularly and bring you a better game.[/p][p][/p][p]Our main communication channel will be the Steam community and our [url="https://discord.gg/zN3YhnUKKg"]Discord[/url]. We'll also use [url="https://x.com/Siloegi_Operate"]Twitter[/url] and Reddit as secondary channels to share ongoing updates with you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/0691ec76e662c4ac026f991b6ac7cdcb115f3e03.gif"][/img][/p][p]We appreciate your support. Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/zN3YhnUKKg"]  [/url][/p]
